og_description: In this chapter, Han Li's performance of a naive young master is interrupted by a critical intelligence drop. A classic RMJI social tribulation.

twitter_description: Han Li’s soundproof-barrier-piercing ears just landed him a juicy, dangerous secret. The court of public opinion has nothing on a cultivator's whispered woes.

lore_anchors.definition: A Foundation Establishment technique that withdraws all spiritual energy into the body, allowing a high-level cultivator to appear as a mortal to lower-level observers.
A basic Qi Condensation–level spell that creates a silent zone for private conversation, but is vulnerable to the superior Divine Sense of a higher-realm cultivator.
A group of five rogue cultivators who have been captured and placed under a lethal restriction by a masked, Foundation Establishment–level enemy.
